title: creative16-v1 episode result
description: Required fields on each episode JSON. Ground truth is lfnav/eval/run.py run_episode output. Extra keys from run.py are allowed. task and policy are aliases of task_name and policy_name.

task.description: Task id, e.g. 1-4. Same as task_name.

sr_b.description: Primary metric: conditions hold and aligned-ray distance <= judge.radius.

sr_a.description: Conditions hold in the same camera view (MP5-style).

initial_target_distance.description: Start distance used for SPL. String form is "> N" when beyond lidar range.
